text:
alex: Pushed a relnotes draft to https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 — focused on the new routing policy and batching tuning. Can someone scan for missing deps/caveats and any SDK snippet breaks?

jamie: Looking now. Quick heads-up: the dep graph callout that mentions `redis-prefix-cache` is out of date (we removed that in dedicated v0.9). Might need a line saying: 'deprecated integrations: redis-prefix-cache — replaced by unified-kv-cache'.

sasha: Also we should localize the short bullets for EU/JP pages before publishing. I can start with the JP copy. Do we have translator slots? @jamie could you unblock? :jp_flag: :sparkles: 

liam: small snippet nit: the Python SDK example currently uses `model_alias='kestrel'` — should be `model_alias='kestrel-v2'` to match the runtime mapping. Otherwise the code sample will 404 for users.

alex: Good catches. I'll update the draft. Plan: (1) add deprecation callout for redis-prefix-cache, (2) change SDK snippets to kestrel-v2, (3) run linkcheck, (4) tag localization.

jamie: I can run linkcheck and a quick deps scan later today. Command I use: `scripts/linkcheck.sh docs/relnotes --report=artifacts/linkcheck-relnotes.json` — will post results.

liam: Also adding a known-issue bullet: "Dedicated autoscale can temporarily route to fallback models during cold-starts — see mitigation steps" — short steps in the relnotes would help CS.

alex: +1 on the known issue blurb. Keep it short: one-line summary + pointer to KB.

docs-bot: PR #492 updated by alex — changed files: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/python/kestrel_example.md. CI: linkcheck triggered.

jamie: linkcheck results: 3 broken anchors, 1 missing image, 2 outdated external links. I'll open a tiny PR for anchor fixes.

alex: Thanks — can you add the list of anchors in the PR description so I can vend the redirects? Also, for the external links: can we add a short redirect note rather than changing canonical links? Some customers rely on those anchors.

jamie: Yep. PR #495 opened for anchor fixes. Description includes broken anchors + suggested redirects.

sasha: I've started JP translation draft in /i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md — will push a PR once anchors are stabilized. Need content freeze by EOD tomorrow if we want it in the release.

liam: One more snippet check: JS example uses `client.generate({model: 'kestrel'})` — same change to `kestrel-v2`. I can patch both snippets in a single PR.

alex: Cool. I'll wait for jamie's anchor PR to land then cut a follow-up relnotes patch for depgraph + snippets + known-issue blurb.

jamie: ETA for anchor PR merge: ~2 hours (waiting for CI flake). After that I'll rerun linkcheck and post final report.

alex: If CI flake blocks, we can cherry-pick commits onto staging to unblock the localization pipeline.

sasha: Noted. Tagging @translations-team and @cs for visibility.

liam: small suggested wording for known issue (copy-paste):
```
Known issue: brief autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: occasional fallback to a smaller model during high-concurrency cold-starts
- Mitigation: pin model_variant on dedicated routes or increase warm-pool size
- Tracked: INF-3124
```

alex: Perfect. I'll add that verbatim under "Known issues" with a KB link to INF-3124.

jamie: Linkcheck green after PR merge. 0 broken anchors. Ready for final review. :tada:

alex: Final checklist before publish:
- [x] Deprecation callout added
- [x] SDK snippets updated (py/js)
- [x] Known-issue blurb added
- [x] Linkcheck passed
- [ ] Localization: JP draft in progress (sasha)

sasha: Will aim to have JP PR up in ~4 hours. If not, we can ship EN relnotes and follow up with localized patch the next day.

alex: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — I’ll schedule the docs release post-publish announcement once JP status is clear. :rocket:
